name: lifeadmin
description: Life Admin – snap a letter or forward an email; get a plain-English summary, deadlines on one timeline, and help acting on them.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run build:demo -w web && npm run e2e -w web
